description: This file defines interfaces, data structures, and function prototypes for Git transport mechanisms, including credential handling, SSH host key verification, and certificate information within the libgit2 library.

methods.name: git_cred_has_username
methods.description: Checks if a credential object contains a username.

methods.name: git_cred_userpass_plaintext_new
methods.description: Creates a new plaintext username and password credential.

methods.name: git_cred_ssh_key_new
methods.description: Creates a new SSH key credential from file paths.

methods.name: git_cred_ssh_interactive_new
methods.description: Creates a new SSH keyboard-interactive credential.

methods.name: git_cred_ssh_key_from_agent
methods.description: Creates an SSH key credential using an SSH agent.

methods.name: git_cred_ssh_custom_new
methods.description: Creates an SSH credential with a custom signing callback.

methods.name: git_cred_default_new
methods.description: Creates a default credential for mechanisms like NTLM/Kerberos.

methods.name: git_cred_username_new
methods.description: Creates a credential with a specified username.

methods.name: git_cred_ssh_key_memory_new
methods.description: Creates an SSH key credential from in-memory key data.
